dialog.agent:
**Nothing has been generated or charged.** I’ve only used read-only planning tools.

I’d use a cream background, burgundy lettering, jazz-club typography and a simple rooftop/saxophone motif, keeping the same design across all three formats.

### Credit budget
These are **estimates, not an account-specific quote**—I can’t currently verify your balance or the final charge.

| Option | Estimated credits |
|---|---:|
| Two matching stills, at free-plan 640px | From **10** |
| Stills + 10-second generated reel at 480p | About **250** |
| Stills + 5-second generated reel | About **130** |
| Stills + 3-second generated reel | About **82** |

The video estimates use the documented production rate of **24 credits/second**; the two stills start at **5 credits each**. No retries or extra variations are included.

**Cheapest recommendation:** create one design, adapt it into the poster and story, then turn the story into a 10-second static hold or simple pan/zoom in an external editor. That avoids AI-video credits and keeps event lettering from changing during animation. Smaller stills and 480p video are already the lowest free-plan settings; shortening the generated reel saves more.

Two important caveats:
- The text-to-image tool doesn’t directly support **4:5**, so the poster needs an image-edit/reframing step.
- Magic Hour’s guide says commercial use requires a paid subscription, credit-pack purchase or another paid arrangement. If these are promotional assets, check that before spending credits—even though entry is free.

Before proceeding:
- Would you prefer the **cheapest stills + externally assembled reel**, a **shorter generated reel**, or the original **10-second generated reel**?
- Should the reel be silent, and what should move?
- The planner also requires this confirmation: **Should any words appear on it? If so, which, exactly?** I have “Rooftop Jazz”, “17 October 2027”, “7 PM”, “Atlas Roof”, and “Free entry” for all three; you can simply confirm that list.
dialog.user: ok, go ahead with that—the cheapest stills plus externally assembled 10-second reel. Confirmed wording on all three: “Rooftop Jazz”, “17 October 2027”, “7 PM”, “Atlas Roof”, and “Free entry”; audio and movement are your call.

The cheapest route is still:
- **Two 640px stills:** estimated 10 credits total.
- **Silent, static 10-second reel:** assembled from the story image, with no AI-video generation charge.

You can add credits and retry, or make all three in an external design editor without spending Magic Hour credits. I can provide a matching layout and assembly instructions for that route.
